label: trailer
definition: Short (2 to 3 minutes) content promoting an upcoming theatrical feature.

label: teaser
definition: Very short (typically less than 1 minute) content promoting an upcoming theatrical feature.

label: test
definition: Content used to test, calibrate or setup D-Cinema exhibition equipment.

label: rating
definition: Slate or still picture indicating the recommended age group permitted to view the content to follow.

label: advertisement
definition: Content promoting a product or service other than an upcoming feature.

label: short
definition: Non advertising or promotional content (3 to 15 minutes) typically before a theatrical feature.

label: transitional
definition: Extremely short content (1 to 15 seconds) separating unrelated compositions.

label: policy
definition: Content defining the code of conduct for patrons.

label: clip
definition: An excerpt from a longer piece of content that may be displayed on its own or with other clips.

label: promotional
definition: A piece of promotional publicity or advertising.

label: stereo card
definition: 'Please Put Your 3D Glasses On Now' card.

label: episode
definition: Part of a dramatic work such as a serial television program.

label: highlights
definition: Edited sequence of one or more memorable parts of an event, feature, episode or period of time.

label: event
definition: Activity that happens at a given place and time, especially one of importance, including a music performance or a contest making up a sports competition.
